name: A10-0147/2026 – Lukas Mandl – After § 18 – Am 4
title: REPORT on reinforcing development cooperation to address irregular population movements and their root causes in partner countries
part_text: 18a. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to strengthen their capacity to prevent and respond to the instrumentalisation of migrants; stresses the need for enhanced cooperation with partner countries and relevant agencies to detect, prevent and counter such actions;
